description: Extension of the Section 6 Test A null calibration (gv_sec6_h0_v1) to the H0 u0 node 6 (u0 = 2.0), so that the critical value can be interpolated in log u0 up to u0 = 1 (the largest u0 of the paper maps): pi_E = 0 PSPL truths at tE = 30 d, F146 = 19, 21, 23 x g = 0, 1, 4 (9 configurations), 50 realizations each, catalog h0_candidate_v5_blend.parquet. Same pipeline as gv_sec6_h0_v1: runner with SAVE_ARRAYS=1 and fit_policy_test_a_dark_v4.json, lrt_omega_profile.py (one start), then lrt_gross_vitells.py --group-by-config --extra-alphas 0.0027 on the profiles of both runs together.
